name: test_v2
purpose: Stage 1.7 same-corpus independent test: excludes both Stage 1.5 test.jsonl and Stage 1.6 fresh_test.jsonl
disjointness: offsets are multiples of seq_len, so distinct offsets imply distinct token ranges; also checked by sha256
window_rule: non-overlapping windows of seq_len tokens; offsets shuffled by seed; sorted by start
note: Token ids stay local. Do not commit the sampled corpus.
